items.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Can Reach New Highs on Backlog and Margins
items.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) can reach new highs as it converts its growing artificial intelligence (AI) server backlog into revenue and sustains strong margins. After three consecutive earnings reports that triggered double-digit gains, its shares have now lost more than a third of their value since their October highs. That’s despite the Round Rock, Texas-based hardware and software services company raising its annual AI server revenue forecast from $60 billion to $74 billion in just a few months.
